narrative:
Lucas County has 291,780 registered voters, with 59.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 14.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 26.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 12.2 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 27.4% of registrants. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +10.5% D−R vs +19.3% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
